verdict.rationale: Zamzar is an API-based SaaS, so issuing scoped credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows a single API key passed via Bearer or Basic auth, plus separate sandbox and production endpoints. Nothing documents issuing multiple keys, limiting a key's permissions, or creating least-privilege credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
